messages:
Sam (Sales): Hey team, need a tight internal runbook for a POC with a regulated customer. They want Hosted API keys to start, but likely will ask for Dedicated pool and VPC peering. Can we list exact steps, expected timelines, and common blockers?

Maria (Solutions Eng): Short version first: 1) Hosted API keys - minutes. 2) Dedicated pool - 2-5 business days. 3) Private/VPC peering - 1-3 weeks depending on network review.

Sam (Sales): Nice. Need the full checklist I can paste into the customer email.

Maria (Solutions Eng): Paste-ready checklist below (keeps it concise):
- Step A: Hosted POC (fast)
  - Create customer org in console and enable trial credits.
  - Generate API key: go to Console > API Keys > Create key. Provide key via secure channel only.
  - Example quick test: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_test_xxx; curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- Step B: Dedicated pool (predictable throughput)
  - Fill dedicated request template (see template snippet). Attach expected rps, peak seq len, and retention policy.
  - Infra will provision GPUs and return pool id. Provide customer with endpoint and ingress details.
- Step C: Private / VPC Peering
  - Submit VPC intake form with CIDR, peering contact, and required egress rules.
  - Provide TLS certs if using mutual TLS.
  - Coordinate routing and firewall rules (we need 3 outbound IPs whitelisted).

Devon (Infra): Adding the Dedicated request template (paste into ticket):
```
team: sales
customer: <company-name>
workload: poc-chat
rps: 30
peak_seq_len: 1024
sla_target: 200ms p95
expected_duration_days: 30
notes: enable autoscaling, timezone: US-EAST1
```
I inbound this into infra queue. Typical provisioning ETA: 48-96 hours after approval and billing setup.

Priya (Security): Quick sec checklist to include in the customer email:
- Data residency: confirm region (we support us-east, eu-west, ap-south).
- KMS: if they want CMK, note lead time 3-5 days for key integration.
- Audit logs: available via Console > Logs (retention additional charge).
- Answer to common questionnaire items: we are SOC2 in progress, PCI not applicable for model inference, provide MSSP contact.

Sam (Sales): Pricing question: if they run a 30-day POC with 2 small GPUs reserved, rough cost?

Maria (Solutions Eng): Rough estimate: Dedicated small pool (2 x g4dn.xlarge) ~ $6k-9k/month depending on spot vs reserved; plus token usage. Offer: apply $5k POC credit for qualifying deals. Always clarify ingress egress and data transfer charges.

Devon (Infra): Network / firewall guidance to paste:
- Whitelist outbound ports: 443 to our egress IPs (we will give three IPs per region).
- Allow ICMP for MTU debugging optionally.
- If using VPC peering, provide VPC CIDR and a contact for route table updates.

Maria (Solutions Eng): Quick runbook for engineers when granting access:
1) Create org + project in Console.
2) Create API key with name 'poc-<customer>' and set scope to inference only.
3) Attach billing method or apply manual credit.
4) If Dedicated: wait for "pool_provisioned" message from infra. Example infra reply shows: pool_id=ded-abc123 endpoint=https://ded-abc123.redwood.ai
5) Share endpoint and example curl snippet with customer.

Devon (Infra): Example terraform snippet for Dedicated (internal use), please note double-check resource names: 
```
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "poc" {
  name  = "poc-ACME"
  region = "us-east-1"
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  replica_count = 2
}
```
(escape any quotes when pasting into tickets).

Priya (Security): Add to runbook: required docs to attach to the security questionnaire response: 
- Data flow diagram (we have a template),
- TLS termination docs,
- KMS integration doc link: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/kms-integration
I'll pre-fill the common answers; send me the questionnaire PDF.

Sam (Sales): Blockers to call out (for internal checklist):
- No billing setup / PO delays
- Customer network team slow to approve peering
- KMS key approvals and legal review for data residency
- Large models needing special kernel support (may add 3-5 days)

Maria (Solutions Eng): Communication timeline to tell customer:
- Hosted API: minutes to hours.
- Dedicated pool: 2-5 business days after ticket and billing.
- Private/VPC: 1-3 weeks depending on network and legal.

Devon (Infra): Who to ping internally: @Devon (Infra) for pool provisioning, @Maria (Solutions Eng) for onboarding tests, @Priya (Security) for questionnaire follow-up.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4721 for dedicated pool request (assigned to Devon).

Sam (Sales): Perfect — I'll paste this to the customer and add the dedicated request template. Thanks, everyone. :thumbsup:
